questions.title: What will fiscal Q4 2026 GAAP diluted EPS be for Broadcom?
questions.background:
A recent analysis of Broadcom's business prospects was recently posted at [Morningstar](https://www.morningstar.com/podcasts/the-morning-filter/why-broadcom-stock-is-worth-650-2).

`{"format": "bot_tournament_question", "info": {"hash_id": "076826ef409e8b34", "sheet_id": "143"}}`
questions.resolution_criteria: This question resolves as the diluted earnings per share (EPS) in conformity with US generally accepted accounting principles (GAAP) reported in Broadcom's first official quarterly [earnings release](https://investors.broadcom.com/financial-information/financial-news-releases) covering its Q4 FY 2026, expected to be released in December 2026.
questions.fine_print: Only the initially reported figures encompassing the entirety of the quarter will be considered. Any subsequent revisions, corrections, or restatements will not affect resolution.
